DoorCrash visual assets
=======================

This folder keeps the source license notes for free assets used by DoorCrash: No Tip Nitro.

- `assets/models/doorcrash/*.glb` comes from Kenney's Car Kit.
- `assets/img/doorcrash/kenney-*.png` comes from Kenney's Road Textures pack.
- Both packs are distributed as Creative Commons Zero (CC0). Credit is appreciated by Kenney, but not required.
